image_description: Two pieces of rusted, textured metal armor plates (breastplates) displayed against a solid yellow background. The plate on the right is upright and shows a central vertical ridge with rivets at the top corners. The plate on the left is lying on its side, showing the interior or reverse side with attachment straps/bands. The material appears to be aged iron or steel with significant surface corrosion/texture rather than polished shine.
